answer.rationale: Current situation shows onboarding completion down 4% QoQ and activation down 6% QoQ. Memory 86 (shortening onboarding improved completion rates) and Memory 31 (signup simplification improved SMB activation) are directly relevant to both metrics in decline. Verifying these two will confirm the strength and durability of onboarding simplification approaches. The referral incentive (memory_57) targets established customers but doesn't address the immediate activation drop. Promotional pricing (memory_73) addresses competitor pressure but risks margin and long-term value extraction; the pooled cohort issue also adds uncertainty. Activation messaging (memory_91) showed promise but is narrower in scope than fixing the onboarding funnel itself. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) doesn't address the SMB activation crisis. Given the dual decline in completion and activation, and the proven track record in memories 86 and 31, a standard experiment on onboarding simplification offers the highest probability of reversing both metrics while preserving sustainable long-term revenue quality over short-term pricing tactics.
